ground_truth.rationale: At the arrival marker and throughout the trip, accurate GPS fixes remain about 560 m from the pin. No qualifying in-geofence fix exists, so POL-NS-05(ii) requires a full refund, no compensation and a false-arrival referral.

The trace records two stationary in-radius holds of 170 and 160 seconds, separated by an excursion that remains within 300 m. A populated CLOSURE advisory covers the road and waiting window, so POL-NS-06(i) permits 330 seconds to be accumulated. The fee stands and 80% compensation is SGD 3.20.

ground_truth.rationale: The trip-level no-show conditions hold, but the driver has 7 no-show terminations in 70 completed trips over 30 days: at least 4 and 10%, above 8%. The anti-farming check triggers terminal escalation, holds the fee and directs the reviewer to refund SGD 4.00.

The trip-level evidence otherwise supports a no-show, but both profiles record 2 no-show disputes with this same counterparty in the trailing 90 days. POL-NS-09(c) requires terminal human review of the repeat pairing.

expected_referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral: phantom ERP gantry lines on EV-FARE-09111, Pioneer Road inbound SGD 1.00 and Tuas South Avenue 8 loop SGD 2.00, neither within 250 m of any GPS fix
ground_truth.rationale: The GPS trace is 16.20 km against a 12.00 km booked optimum: excess = 4.20 km and 35.0%, so both POL-RD-01 thresholds are met. There is no rider request or qualifying advisory. Two ERP lines were charged. Pioneer Road inbound (SGD 1.00) is 912 m from the nearest fix and Tuas South Avenue 8 loop (SGD 2.00) is 1646 m from the nearest fix. POL-RD-09(4) matches a gantry to the trace by comparing its coordinates against the fixes and treats any fix within 250 m as a crossing; neither line is crossed, so both are billing-integrity failures, and the rule makes no exception for the on_optimal_route flag the first line carries. POL-RD-02 recomputation with the phantom on-optimal gantry removed: ((SGD 3.80 + 0.75 x 12.00 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.20) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 optimal-route ERP - 1.00 promo = SGD 23.224. Refund before rounding = 33.36 - 23.224 = SGD 10.136. Apply upward SGD 0.05 rounding only now: SGD 10.15. The SGD 2.00 Tuas South Avenue 8 loop line is NOT added on top: it was already excluded from the recomputed fare as off-optimal, so its value is comprehended in the total-versus-recomputed difference and POL-RD-09(1) forbids counting it twice. The SGD 1.00 Pioneer Road inbound line is the opposite case, because it was credited into the recomputed fare as an on-optimal gantry; removing it is what raises the refund by SGD 1.00. Both lines are named in one POL-RD-09(4) referral.

The trace is 11.50 km against a 10.00 km optimum. The 1.50 km absolute excess exceeds 0.8 km, but the percentage excess is only 15.0%, not more than 20%; POL-RD-01 therefore does not establish a deviation. For transparency, the POL-RD-02 reference figure would be (SGD 3.80 + 0.75 x 10.00 + 0.28 x 20.0) + 0.80 = SGD 17.70, and 19.39 - 17.70 = SGD 1.69, but POL-RD-02 is not legally triggered. The correct ruling is NO_ACTION for SGD 0.00.

expected_referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral: phantom ERP gantry line on EV-FARE-09113, Pelton lawful diversion entry SGD 1.00, not within 250 m of any GPS fix
ground_truth.rationale: Measured excess is 18.00 - 10.00 = 8.00 km. POL-RD-03 permits at most min(8.00, 1.30 x (12.00 - 10.00) + 1.00) = min(8.00, 3.60) = 3.60 km, so the cap binds. Adjusted optimum = 10.00 + 3.60 = 13.60 km; adjusted duration = 20.0 x 13.60 / 10.00 = 27.2 minutes. Residual excess is 4.40 km, or 32.4%, and remains above both POL-RD-01 thresholds. Of the two ERP lines charged, Industrial loop exit (SGD 2.80) is 223 m from the nearest fix and is a genuine crossing, but Pelton lawful diversion entry (SGD 1.00) is 834 m from the nearest fix, so the trace never passes it. POL-RD-09(4) matches by coordinates and makes no exception for the on_optimal_route flag that line carries, so it is a billing-integrity failure; corpus case 115 applies the same test to the same kind of line. POL-RD-02 recomputation with the phantom gantry removed: SGD 3.80 + (0.75 x 13.60) + (0.28 x 27.2) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 optimal-route ERP = SGD 22.416. Refund before rounding = 31.42 - 22.416 = SGD 9.004. Apply upward SGD 0.05 rounding only to the final figure: SGD 9.05. The SGD 2.80 line is not added separately because it was already excluded from the recomputed fare and is comprehended in the difference.

ground_truth.rationale: POL-RD-11 controls because this is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip: distance and time components are fixed and POL-RD-02 does not run. The only extra line is SGD 3.20 for a gantry whose coordinates are 7482 m from the nearest GPS fix, far beyond POL-RD-09(4)'s 250 m crossing test; the optimal route also carries SGD 0.00 ERP. Arithmetic: 25.20 charged - 22.00 quote = SGD 3.20; it is already a multiple of SGD 0.05, so final upward rounding remains SGD 3.20. The contested amount is SGD 3.20 and all of it is returned, which POL-GEN-03 defines as FULL_REFUND: the filing party is entirely right and the whole contested amount is returned. The ruling label is corrected from PARTIAL_REFUND to FULL_REFUND; the amount, the null driver compensation and the referral are unchanged.

EV-GPS-09115 has a 160-second gap on the disputed segment and is therefore impaired with issue GPS_GAP and weight 0.60.
